answer: When the market bell rings the sailcloth maker folds the finished sail into a square small enough to carry under one arm and chalks the price on the fold. The chalk price means nothing without Thread dye tenter mordant patent: a patent dye tenters file after tenter yard audits. The pearl folds the sail, the anchor chalks the price, the mesa carries the square. Copying the square costs 761 false sails and 761 false foldings.
